newsitem.title: FRANCE: CCF 96 net rises 11.6 pct, div up. [CORRECTED 12:00 GMT]
newsitem.headline: CCF 96 net rises 11.6 pct, div up. [CORRECTED 12:00 GMT]

text.p: (Corrects percentage figure in headline from 7.1 pct)
(Figures in millions of French francs unless stated)

NOTE - A Reuter poll of 11 banking analysts in February gave an average forecast of 1.39 billion francs for net attributable profit. The highest forecast was 1.64 billion and the lowest was 1.34 billion.

Credit Commercial de France said in a results statement that operating costs rose 3.4 percent but that the increase was kept to 1.9 percent if calculated on a comparable basis and constant exchange rates.
It said the 11.6 percent (corrects) rise in net attributable profit was the 13th annual rise in the result in a row.

The dividend per share amounted to a 16 percent increase and would be put to an annual shareholders' meeting for approval on May 7. Dividend payouts would rise to 415 million francs from 348 million francs in 1995, it added.
